description: Transport backward-Lagrangian origin-error validation baseline (validated values; recompute with scripts/freeze_validation_baseline.py).

incidents.name: MSC Chitra / Khalijia-III collision, Mumbai
incidents.note: Fresh, weakly-advected spill in moderate current; backtracking reconstructs source within ~17 km.

incidents.name: MT Jipro / Neftis collision, Mumbai
incidents.note: Only ~60/100 particles stay active (limited forcing footprint near Mumbai shelf); error is moderate.

incidents.name: GAL Constructor grounding, Cyclone Tauktae
incidents.note: Vessel GROUNDED during Cyclone Tauktae (winds ~10 m/s); source not advecting with current, so backtracking a spreading sheen under cyclone wind inherently spreads the origin. Metocean file fixed to 2021-05-14..21.

incidents.name: Ennore/Chennai coastal oil spill
incidents.note: Source sits in a strong northward coastal current (~0.5 m/s); 24 h backward advection legitimately moves the inferred origin ~48-53 km south. Robust across seeds.

incidents.name: Kandla / Gulf of Kutch spill
incidents.note: Best case; weak currents so backtracking nearly pins the source (~6 km).
